title: Shapes and areas
description:
Use inheritance to treat different shapes the same way.

```
Circle r=2: area 12.57, perimeter 12.57
Rectangle 3x4: area 12.00, perimeter 14.00
Square 5: area 25.00, perimeter 20.00
Largest: Square 5
```
hints: `Square.__init__(self, side)` can call `super().__init__(side, side)`, so it gets `area` and `perimeter` from `Rectangle` for free.
`max(shapes, key=lambda s: s.area())` finds the largest shape.
requirements: A base class `Shape` with `area()` and `perimeter()` that raise `NotImplementedError`, and a `describe()` method that uses them.
Put the shapes in a list, describe each one, then print the one with the largest area.
stretch: Make `Shape` an abstract base class with `abc.ABC` and `@abstractmethod`, and add a `Triangle`.
